isolation.why: honcho is an external app we have never packaged; a fresh clone is not a clean target. Run it where a deploy cannot reach host state, whatever its compose declares (fixed project name, loopback ports, named volumes).

bringup.name: compose-up-minimal-3
bringup.run: docker compose up -d --build --wait --wait-timeout 600 database redis api

health.name: database
health.check: docker compose exec -T database pg_isready -U postgres

health.name: redis
health.check: docker compose exec -T redis redis-cli ping

acceptance.name: workspace-crud-roundtrip
acceptance.check: curl -fsS -X POST http://localhost:8000/v3/workspaces -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name":"hoist-smoke"}' | grep -q hoist-smoke
